name: Eddy
summary: Eddy is a small-business HR system whose onboarding packets give each new hire a task list and online forms to sign, including W-4 and I-9. Pricing is published: $4 or $8 per person a month plus a $50 or $75 monthly base fee, billed month to month with no long contract.

facts.text: The onboarding page says admins can reuse packet templates for different roles and track which tasks each new hire has finished and which are outstanding.
The onboarding page says new hires can fill out and sign all necessary forms, including W-4s and I-9s, and that I-9 verification for managers and admins is also done online.

The onboarding page says an uploaded employee handbook can be made signable in two clicks, and that new hires can self-onboard before their first day. It does not use the word portal or say how new hires log in.
The pricing page says billing counts active employees only, so inactive staff such as seasonal workers or people on leave are not charged.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Plus a $50 monthly base fee. The page offers a free account and does not state a trial length

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Plus a $75 monthly base fee. Marked most popular

hiddenCosts: Payroll is an add-on at $6 per person plus a $50 monthly base fee.
Hiring is an add-on at $199 a month.
Next-day pay and boosted job postings carry extra charges the page does not price.
The pricing page states no country or currency code, so the dollar figures may differ outside the US.

contract.cancellation: The pricing page says service is month to month and can be cancelled anytime. Upgrades apply immediately and downgrades start at the next billing period.
